name: Stickies color icons
about: Stickies color icons is a free, open-source icon set with 200 icons designed by Streamline. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.

faqs.q: Are Stickies color icons free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 200 Stickies color icons are open source under the CC BY 4.0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the CC BY 4.0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Stickies color icons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Stickies color icons are there?
faqs.a: There are 200 icons in the Stickies color icons set, designed by Streamline. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Stickies color icons?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Stickies color icons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
